landing_title: capercailye – print your own hiking map from OpenStreetMap
landing_description: Make your own printable hiking map: pick an area, check the pages, export an A4 PDF. Built on OpenStreetMap with a map style designed for hikers.
landing_og_title: capercailye – print your own hiking map
landing_og_description: Pick an area, check the pages, export an A4 PDF. Made from OpenStreetMap with a map style built for hikers.
landing_jsonld_description: Web app that turns OpenStreetMap data into a printable hiking map: pick an area, check the pages and export an A4 PDF.
landing_hero_lead: Pick an area, check the pages, export an A4 PDF. Made from OpenStreetMap with a map style built for hikers.
landing_alt_dahn_hero: Hiking map of Dahn in the Palatinate Forest: marked trails with waymark signs, huts, viewpoints and contour lines with shaded relief around the town
landing_less_text: If you don't want to keep checking your phone while you walk, take the map on paper. No battery, no reception needed, the whole day at a glance, and more time for the woods around you.
landing_features_lead: A map you can fold into your pocket, made for the area you are actually going to walk.
landing_print_alt: Print view of two numbered A4 portrait pages at 1:25,000 around the Feldberg, with the page frame, overlap and a shaded border around the printed area
landing_print_text: Set the area and let the app cut it into A4 pages. You get one PDF, ready to print.
landing_print_tick_scale: Scale 1:15,000, 1:25,000 or 1:50,000, or choose the number of pages
landing_print_tick_margin: Scale bar and source line on the page margin
landing_gpx_alt: Hiking map east of Dahn with an uploaded GPX track drawn in magenta over the trails, waymarks and contour lines
landing_gpx_text: Load your own track or drop the file onto the map. It shows up in magenta, the classic print colour of orienteering maps, on top of the map.
landing_gpx_tick_area: Set the print area around the track with one click
landing_style_alt: Hiking map of the Calmont and Bremm on the Moselle: marked trails with waymarks, a steep rocky vineyard slope with contour lines, hillshade, viewpoints and inns
landing_style_text: The map shows what helps on a walk instead of everything. Paths by difficulty, marked hiking routes with their real waymarks placed along the trails, contour lines and hillshade.
landing_chips_label: Points of interest on the map
landing_paper_title: Paper maps are not web maps.
landing_paper_lead: Paper maps are more demanding: everything important has to be on the sheet and readable without zooming. That's why you can't just print a web map. capercailye sets out to solve exactly this: the map style picks what matters and moves symbols apart instead of stacking them on top of each other.
landing_step_explore_text: Search for a place and look around the map.
landing_step_draw_text: Drag out the area you want to take with you.
landing_step_pages_text: Check the pages, export the PDF and print it.
landing_gallery_lead: Screenshots of the map itself, no mock-ups.
landing_dahn_alt: Hiking map of the Dahner Felsenland: forested valleys with many marked trails, waymarks, rock formations, huts and picnic spots next to the town of Dahn
landing_calmont_alt: Hiking map of the Moselle loop at Bremm with the steep Calmont slope, vineyard trails, waymarks, viewpoints and contour lines
landing_calmont_caption_html: Calmont at Bremm on the Moselle, Rhineland-Palatinate
landing_schwarzwald_alt: Overview map of the whole Black Forest from Karlsruhe to Lake Constance with forest areas, rivers, faint relief and town names
landing_schwarzwald_caption_html: The Black Forest as a whole, Baden-Württemberg
landing_feldberg_alt: Hiking map of the Feldberg summit in the Southern Black Forest with marked trails, waymarks, huts, streams and dense contour lines
landing_img_credit_html: Map images: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL) · Relief: Mapterhorn, German state survey agencies, modified · Bus stops (where shown): DELFI e.V. / gtfs.de, analysed (CC BY 4.0) · Full sources
landing_coverage_html: Coverage: map data is available for all of Germany.
landing_thanks_lead: capercailye is free to use and open source (MIT). It only exists because other people decided to share their work openly, and we are grateful to every one of them.
landing_thanks_osm_html: OpenStreetMap: the map data itself, mapped and maintained by thousands of volunteers.
landing_thanks_mapterhorn_html: Mapterhorn: open elevation tiles for hillshade and contour lines, built on the open data of the state surveying offices.
landing_thanks_photon_html: Photon by komoot: the place search.
landing_thanks_gtfs_html: gtfs.de: timetable data for the bus stops.
landing_thanks_maplibre_html: MapLibre GL JS: draws the map in your browser.
landing_thanks_pmtiles_html: PMTiles by Protomaps: map tiles in a single file, no tile server needed.
landing_thanks_planetiler_html: Planetiler: turns OpenStreetMap data into vector tiles.
landing_thanks_tippecanoe_html: tippecanoe: builds the bus stop tiles.
landing_thanks_contour_html: maplibre-contour: draws the contour lines from elevation data.
app_search_label: Search for a place or peak
app_hint_draw: Drag a rectangle on the map · Esc cancels
app_gpx_hint: Or drag a file onto the map.
app_notice_text: The map data comes from OpenStreetMap and other sources and is not editorially checked. Trails, waymarks and closures may be missing, outdated or wrong. The map is no substitute for finding your way on site; use at your own risk.
